v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Suscitábit * Deus cæli regnum quod commínuet et consúmet univérsa regna, et ipsum stabit in ætérnum.
text.en: The God of heaven * will set up a kingdom that shall break in pieces and shall consume all these kingdoms, and itself shall stand for ever.

text.la: Dedit ei Dóminus * potestátem et honórem et regnum; et omnes pópuli, tribus et linguæ ipsi sérvient.
text.en: The Lord gave him * power and glory, and a kingdom; and all peoples, tribes and tongues shall serve him.

text.la: Exíbunt aquæ vivæ * de Ierúsalem; et erit Dóminus Rex super omnem terram.
text.en: Living waters shall go out * from Jerusalem; and the Lord shall be king over all the earth.

text.la: Magnificábitur * usque ad términos terræ, et erit iste pax.
text.en: Now shall he be magnified * even to the ends of the earth, and this man shall be our peace.

text.la: Gens et regnum * quod non servíerit tibi, períbit: et gentes solitúdine vastabúntur.
text.en: The nation and the kingdom * that will not serve thee, shall perish: and the Gentiles shall be wasted with desolation.

text.la: Fratres: Grátias ágimus Deo Patri, qui dignos nos fecit in partem sortis sanctórum in lúmine, qui erípuit nos de potestáte tenebrárum, et tránstulit in regnum Fílii dilectiónis suæ.
text.en: Brethren: We give thanks to God the Father, who hath made us worthy to be partakers of the lot of the saints in light, who hath delivered us from the power of darkness, and hath translated us into the kingdom of the Son of his love.

r.en: And there shall be no end of peace.

text.la: Fecit nos Deo * et Patri suo regnum, primogénitus mortuórum, et Princeps regum terræ, allelúia.
text.en: He hath made us * a kingdom to God and his Father: the first begotten of the dead, and the Prince of the kings of the earth, alleluia.

text.la: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, qui in dilécto Fílio tuo, universórum Rege, ómnia instauráre voluísti: concéde propítius; ut cunctæ famíliæ géntium, peccáti vúlnere disgregátæ, eius suavíssimo subdántur império:
text.en: Almighty and everlasting God, who in thy beloved Son, the King of the whole world, hast willed to restore all things: mercifully grant that all the families of nations, now kept apart by the wound of sin, may be brought under the sweet yoke of his rule. Who with thee liveth and reigneth, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
